title: Sable and the Letter
author: August Ishikawa
blurb: Odile Joubert, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the tide gives up what it took.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
